entities.summary: Oreol Camejo Durruthy is a volleyball player from Cuba, who plays as an outside hitter for Japanese club Hiroshima Thunders. He became Best Setter at the first 2008 Olympic Qualification Tournament in Düsseldorf, where Cuba ended up in second place and missed qualification for the 2008 Summer Olympics in Beijing.
